name: tf.buy: hire through the layer, graded and settled

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ txHash: (($('Get demand').last().json.body?.demand || {}).ending || {}).tx || '', chainId: ($('Get demand').last().json.body?.demand || {}).chainId || 36927, agentAddress: ((($json.body || {}).job || {}).payee || {}).address || '' }) }}

parameters.content:
## tf.buy
A need in words (`POST /v1/demands`): the layer matches a seller, hires it, grades the delivery by code, settles it, and this flow polls the demand, reads the job (who did the work, who was paid) and asks the chain for its verdict (`POST /v1/attest/hire`: REAL · FABRICATED · UNVERIFIED). The buyer pays only for work that passed.
